name: All That's Left of Me
source:
All That's Left Of Me is a lesbian visual novel. You take on the role of Chelsea, a 20 year old woman who moves into a new house with her girlfriend. But soon things take a terrible turn when a mysterious figure begins terrorizing  them. 

[From [url=https://silly-me.itch.io/all-thats-left-of-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我剩下的一切》是一部女同性恋视觉小说。你扮演切尔西的角色，一位20岁的女性，和她的女朋友搬进了新房子。但很快，当一个神秘人物开始恐吓他们时，事情发生了可怕的转变。

[来自[url=https://silly-me.itch.io/all-thats-left-of-me]Itch.io[/url]]
